My Pollux and Castor is doing just fine with an Aigis and Xu; Gmurphy has her complete team; Mouchette has Thais and Hameln; Kath has Horla, Clem, and Arachne;  Pontos is with Corpo, Saya, and Vortice. Keyflare Rouse on Turn 1
I think I wanna slot her to Mouchette and the team would be like Mouchette, Hameln, Thais, and Glotan. But, won't this team be too arithmetic heavy?
It works

PChaos
- Grants 2000 Keyflare at the Start of Battle
- Base Keyflare of 2000, maximum Keyflare of 4000
- L can Keyflare Rouse Mouchette on Turn 1, then GLotan on Turn 2 
- L or gamble for Triple Posse / Double-Play Posse
GLotan Strike Sub DPS
- Play her base Strike / Short Blade / Long Blade, all 3 can and will trigger Mouchette's Pursuits
If you're short on Arith, you can equip Mouse Posse so that you immediately gain some Arith to use after using your Rouse
Since PChaos releases the equipped Posse immediately after casting your Rouse
You can also just let it Retain in your Hand
As PChaos also gives Keyflare Rouses Prepare 1
So you can play the Keyflare Rouse + equipped Posse for free
